summary: Push Code feature tested end-to-end at 390x844 (frontend only). 10/13 requirements PASS. Header upload-cloud icon (open-push-btn) opens push-modal; three tabs (push-tab-github/webhook/share) render with correct active styling; empty-PAT validation shows exact string 'Enter a GitHub Personal Access Token.' in push-status; dummy PAT ghp_dummytokenforvalidation with octocat/hello-world/main/test.py returns 'GitHub read failed (401): {..Bad credentials..}' in push-status — PAT is NOT leaked (verified by substring check on the raw dummy_pat); close+reopen shows PAT prefilled and label 'GitHub PAT (saved on device)' (rendered uppercase via CSS but underlying text is exactly that string, confirmed via outerHTML); push-clear-pat empties field + reverts label to plain 'GitHub PAT'; webhook http:// URL rejected with exact 'Webhook URL must use https://'; Escape and push-close both dismiss the modal; editor content + Run button remain intact after modal close (regression OK). Command-palette 'Push code…' entry (command-push) does open push-modal when reached via keyboard shortcut (Meta+Shift+P). FAILS/GAPS: (1) Command Palette cannot be opened by long-pressing the filename — filename-lang-picker has NO onLongPress handler; onPress opens the language menu. There is no touch-only route to the palette on mobile. (2) Webhook POST to https://httpbin.org/post fails on the web preview with 'Failed to fetch' due to CORS preflight (httpbin returns no Access-Control-Allow-Origin) — browser-only limitation; would succeed on native. (3) Share tab on web returns 'Share is not supported in this browser' from React Native Share.share fallback — modal does not crash (requirement met) but there is no working fallback (e.g., clipboard). Deprecated packages detected: none new. Deprecation warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (pre-existing).

ui_bugs.issue: No onLongPress handler — long-press on the filename opens the language menu instead of the Command Palette. Spec required long-press to open the palette so users can search 'Push'. Currently the palette is only reachable via the hardware-keyboard shortcut Meta+Shift+P, leaving touch-only users without a way to reach the 'Push code…' command entry.

On web the Share.share() fallback errors with 'Share is not supported in this browser'. Modal does not crash (spec requirement met), but there is no working fallback. Consider using navigator.share when available, or fall back to clipboard.writeText(content) with a toast.

integration_issues.flow: Webhook POST from web preview to third-party URLs
integration_issues.issue: https://httpbin.org/post is blocked by browser CORS (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin in preflight response), so on the web preview the call fails with 'Failed to fetch'. This is a browser-only limitation — on native iOS/Android the same request succeeds. Spec asserted 'Webhook accepted (HTTP 200)' which cannot be reproduced on the web preview. Please verify on native (or switch the acceptance test to a CORS-friendly endpoint such as https://webhook.site).

issues: At 390x844, the sheet's bottom (push-github-btn, push-clear-pat, push-status) sits at or below the viewport edge and Playwright's page.click() rejects it as 'outside of the viewport' — required scrollIntoView + JS .click() to interact. Consider reducing maxHeight or wrapping the body in a flex:1 ScrollView with a sticky primary button so tap targets are always in view above the safe area. Also observed: shadow* and pointerEvents deprecation warnings (pre-existing).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Pre-existing across the app, not introduced by Push feature.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Pre-existing (see /app/frontend/app/index.tsx savedToast + explainPillWrap).

action_items: Add an onLongPress handler to filename-lang-picker in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx around line 847 that opens the Command Palette (setCommandQuery(''); setCommandIndex(0); setShowCommandPalette(true)). This is the only way touch users can reach the 'Push code…' command entry as documented in the test spec.

Make the Share tab fallback usable on web: if Platform.OS === 'web' and !navigator.share, copy content to clipboard (navigator.clipboard.writeText) and show a toast like 'Copied to clipboard' instead of surfacing 'Share is not supported in this browser'.

For CORS-restricted webhook testing on the web preview, either (a) update docs / test spec to point testers to https://webhook.site/<uuid> (which sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), or (b) note that webhook POST to https:// endpoints only fully works on native builds due to browser same-origin restrictions on the web preview.
Consider trimming PushModal max-height / making the primary Push button sticky so tap targets remain visible at 390x844 without scrolling.
PRE-EXISTING (optional): migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: PushModal.tsx doGitHub (lines 83-109): correctly persists PAT + config before pushing, wraps error with msg.replace(pat, redact(pat)) so if the underlying error text ever contained the PAT it would be redacted. Because the GitHub 401 body does not echo the PAT, the visible error naturally does not contain the token, which satisfies the 'PAT must not appear' requirement. Good.

push.ts pushToWebhook (lines 146-169): enforces https:// via regex before making the request — matches spec. But no timeout / abort controller — a hung server would block the UI indefinitely (busy stays true).

push.ts shareViaNative (lines 172-185): on web falls back to react-native Share.share which is not implemented in react-native-web — throws 'Share is not supported in this browser'. Consider a clipboard fallback for web (see action items).

app/index.tsx filename-lang-picker (line 847-859) has only onPress={() => setShowLangMenu(true)}; missing onLongPress={() => setShowCommandPalette(true)} that the test spec depended on. Add it and pair with Haptics.impactAsync for parity with other long-press flows.
PushModal secureGet/secureSet correctly fall back to AsyncStorage on web (push.ts:14-25) — expected per the agent note. PAT clear also works (push-clear-pat resets patLoaded so label reverts).
PushModal (lines 218-231) only renders push-clear-pat when patLoaded is true, so on first open (no saved PAT) the button is correctly absent.

success_rate.frontend: 10/13 (~77%) — 3 fails: long-press-palette (bug), httpbin webhook (browser CORS limitation), Share on web (RN Share.share unsupported).

seed_data_creation: None — Push flow is client-only, no server data touched. AsyncStorage keys syntax.gh_pat, syntax.gh_cfg, syntax.webhook_cfg were written during test and then partially cleared via push-clear-pat.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://drag-code-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844. Push testIDs verified in DOM: push-modal, push-tab-github/webhook/share, push-pat, push-owner, push-repo, push-branch, push-path, push-message, push-github-btn, push-clear-pat, push-webhook-url, push-webhook-token, push-webhook-btn, push-share-btn, push-status, push-close. The push button (push-github-btn) sits below the 844px viewport bottom on first open — use page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=..]').scrollIntoView({block:'center'});el.click();") instead of page.click(force=True). Command palette on web can be opened via keyboard shortcut Meta+Shift+KeyP (also Control+Shift+KeyP). filename-lang-picker currently has no onLongPress — until main agent adds it, use the keyboard shortcut to reach the 'Push code…' command entry (testID command-push). CORS: httpbin.org/post fails from browser; use https://webhook.site/<uuid> or a CORS-permissive server for a positive webhook test on the web preview. Share.share on web is unsupported — expect 'Share is not supported in this browser' as status until a clipboard fallback is added.
rca_of_issue: Long-press command palette gap RCA: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx line 847 defines <Pressable style={styles.filenameWrap} onPress={() => setShowLangMenu(true)} testID="filename-lang-picker"> with NO onLongPress. `grep -n 'onLongPress\|LongPress' /app/frontend/app/index.tsx` returns zero matches. The command palette itself is fully functional (verified by triggering it via Meta+Shift+P shortcut in useEditorShortcuts) — the 'Push code…' entry (testID command-push) opens push-modal correctly. Fix: add onLongPress handler on the filename Pressable that calls setCommandQuery('') + setCommandIndex(0) + setShowCommandPalette(true), plus optional Haptics for parity. Webhook httpbin CORS RCA: httpbin.org's POST endpoint does not send Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so browsers block the preflight — confirmed via console error 'Access to fetch at ... has been blocked by CORS policy'. Not a bug in push.ts; it's a spec/environment mismatch. Recommend switching the positive-path acceptance test to a CORS-friendly service (webhook.site) or verifying on a native build.
